app.name: Vun
app.tagline: Capture a thought, and find a first step small enough to start.

capture.hint: Enter saves to your inbox. Shift+Enter adds a new line. Escape closes without saving.
capture.voice_recording: Listening. Speak naturally, or press Escape to cancel.

nudge.title: A gentle check-in from Vun
nudge.short_break: A short break might help. Would you like a 60-second breathing timer or smaller steps?
nudge.focus_hint: Press Tab to move between actions, or Escape to close.

hotkey.conflict_banner: Shortcut {binding} is already used by another app. You can choose a different one below.

workspace.activity_status_running: Activity sensing is active (app name and idle seconds only, never window titles).
workspace.activity_status_paused: Activity sensing is paused from the tray.
workspace.activity_status_locked: Activity sensing is paused while your screen is locked.
workspace.launch_at_login_label: Start Vun minimized when you sign in
workspace.launch_at_login_note: Off by default. You can change this anytime here or in the tray menu.
workspace.degraded_local_only: Working offline with local features only. Cloud structuring is paused.
workspace.disclaimer: Vun is a personal cognitive-scaffolding tool. It is not a medical device and does not replace professional support.

settings.countdowns_note: Countdowns stay off by default because a visible timer can feel like pressure.
settings.elapsed_time_note: Elapsed time is separate from countdowns so you can choose what feels calmer.

toast.hotkey_conflict_body: Another app is using {binding}. Open Settings to pick another shortcut.
